verdict.rationale: Browserbase's docs directly state that developers can 'start building right away with 30+ ready-made templates', which matches the story. The evidence is a single marketing-level line with no detail on what the templates cover or how they are used. Missing for 10: documentation of template contents, languages and use cases, a template gallery or instantiation workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start building immediately using a library of ready-made project templates

citations.quote: Start building right away with 30+ ready-made templates.
